citations.title: Dalton Schultz Biography - ESPN

excerpts:
* [Print](https://www.espn.com/espn/print?id=21951829)

STANFORD, Calif. -- Stanford tight end [Dalton Schultz](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/3117256/dalton-schultz) will skip his final season of eligibility and enter the NFL draft.

Schultz said Wednesday that he will cherish his memories from Stanford but wants to pursue his childhood dream of playing in the NFL.

Schultz was an All-Pac-12 selection this season when he had 22 catches for 212 yards and three touchdowns. In three seasons for the Cardinal, Schultz had 55 catches for 555 yards and five TDs.
citations.title: Stanford TE Dalton Schultz enters NFL draft - ESPN

excerpts:
A fourth-round pick in 2018 out of [Stanford](https://www.espn.com/college-football/team/_/id/24/stanford-cardinal) , Schultz became a full-time starter in 2020 and was one of quarterback [Dak Prescott](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/2577417/dak-prescott) 's trusted targets. He caught 63 passes for 615 yards and four touchdowns in 2020 and followed that up with a 78-catch, 808-yard, eight-touchdown season in 2021.

Schultz is fifth in Cowboys team history among catches for tight ends with 211 and has four multiple-touchdown games, trailing only Jason Witten and Billy Joe DuPree (five each) in team history.

Over the past three seasons, Singletary was the primary running back for the [Buffalo Bills](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/buf/buffalo-bills) .
